name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY (Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana)
ministry: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare / NHA
description: World's largest government-funded health insurance scheme providing ₹5 lakh/year coverage to 55 crore beneficiaries for secondary and tertiary hospitalization.
eligibility: Families listed in SECC 2011 database (rural deprived + urban occupational categories)
No restriction on family size or age
Identified automatically — no need to enroll
benefits: ₹5 lakh per family per year for 1,929 medical procedures including surgery, chemotherapy, day care. Cashless at 29,000+ empanelled hospitals. Pre-existing diseases covered from day 1.
documents: Ration Card / BPL card (to verify eligibility)
how_to_apply: Check eligibility at pmjay.gov.in or call 14555. Visit nearest empanelled hospital with Aadhaar — Ayushman card generated free at hospital or CSC.

name: ABHA (Ayushman Bharat Health Account) — Digital Health ID
ministry: National Health Authority (NHA) / Ministry of Health
description: 14-digit unique health ID for every citizen to store and access all health records digitally — prescriptions, lab reports, discharge summaries.
eligibility: All Indian citizens regardless of income or insurance status
benefits: Free digital health record storage. Access your entire medical history from any doctor or hospital. Integrated with PMJAY, CoWIN, and all ABDM-linked apps.
documents: Aadhaar Card or mobile number (for mobile-based ABHA)
PAN Card (optional alternative for non-Aadhaar ABHA)
how_to_apply: Create ABHA at abdm.gov.in, ABHA mobile app, or through any empanelled hospital/PHC

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Aushadhi Pariyojana (PMJAP)
description: Over 10,000 Jan Aushadhi Kendras across India providing quality generic medicines at 50-90% lower prices than branded medicines.
eligibility: All citizens — no income or category restriction
benefits: Generic medicines at 50-90% cheaper than market price. 1,900+ medicines and 300+ surgical items available. Free medicine supply for TB, Cancer (some drugs) under special schemes.
documents: Valid prescription from doctor (for prescription medicines)
No documents needed for OTC medicines
how_to_apply: Visit nearest Jan Aushadhi Kendra (find at janaushadhi.gov.in/store_locator). Show doctor's prescription.

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY) — Safe Motherhood
ministry: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare / NHM
description: Cash incentive for institutional delivery to reduce maternal and infant mortality — especially for BPL and rural women.
eligibility: Pregnant women of BPL/SC/ST households in Low Performing States (LPS)
In High Performing States (HPS): only BPL women aged 19+ for up to 2 live births
benefits: ₹1,400 cash for rural deliveries in LPS (UP, Uttarakhand, Bihar, Jharkhand, MP, Chhattisgarh, Assam, Rajasthan, Odisha, J&K). ₹1,000 in HPS. ASHA worker gets ₹600 per rural LPS case.
how_to_apply: Register at nearest government health facility / Anganwadi centre. ASHA worker assists with registration and hospital delivery arrangement.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
description: Conditional cash benefit of ₹5,000 to pregnant and lactating mothers for first live birth to compensate for wage loss and improve nutrition.
eligibility: All pregnant women 19 years or older for first live child
Excludes central / state government employees and women receiving similar benefits
benefits: ₹3,000 on first ANC registration + ₹2,000 after child birth registration and first cycle of vaccination. Total: ₹5,000. Second girl child gets ₹6,000 in one installment.
how_to_apply: Apply at Anganwadi centre, ASHA worker, or nearest health facility. Also at pmmvy.wcd.gov.in

name: Nikshay Poshan Yojana — TB Patient Nutritional Support
description: Direct cash benefit of ₹500/month to all notified TB patients throughout their treatment period to support nutrition.
eligibility: All TB patients notified in the Nikshay portal (government and private treatment)
Applies to all types of TB — Drug-Sensitive (DS-TB) and Drug-Resistant (DR-TB)
benefits: ₹500/month directly into bank account for entire treatment duration (6-24 months). DR-TB patients get additional ₹1,000/month.
documents: TB diagnosis report / prescription from doctor
how_to_apply: TB patient is automatically enrolled by treating facility on the Nikshay portal. Visit nikshay.in to check status.

name: Tele-MANAS — National Tele Mental Health Programme
ministry: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare / NIMHANS
description: Free 24x7 tele-mental health counselling service through a network of 53 mental health institutions across all states.
eligibility: All citizens with mental health concerns — no income, age, or category restriction
benefits: Free audio/video counselling, crisis intervention, referral to nearest mental health facility. Available in multiple regional languages. Call is free.
how_to_apply: Call Tele-MANAS helpline: 14416 (toll-free, 24x7). WhatsApp or chat options also available through NMH app.

name: National Health Mission (NHM) Free Services at PHC/CHC
description: Free OPD consultation, essential medicines, diagnostics (blood tests, X-ray, ultrasound), and ambulance at government PHC/CHC/District Hospitals.
eligibility: All citizens — no income or category restriction for basic services
benefits: Free OPD visits, free lab tests (74+ parameters under Free Diagnostics), free 348 essential medicines at public health facilities, free 108 ambulance service.
documents: Aadhaar Card (recommended but not mandatory for OPD)
how_to_apply: Visit nearest Primary Health Centre (PHC), Community Health Centre (CHC), or Government District Hospital. No prior appointment needed.

name: Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana (RVY) — Senior Citizen Assistive Devices
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment / ALIMCO
description: Free assistive living devices for senior citizens (60+) from BPL households with age-related disabilities.
eligibility: Senior citizens aged 60 years and above
Belong to BPL households
Have age-related impairments like low vision, hearing loss, mobility issues, or edentulism
benefits: Free walking sticks, elbow crutches, walkers, tripods, hearing aids, wheelchairs, artificial dentures, spectacles as per medical assessment.
how_to_apply: Apply through District Social Welfare Office or at ALIMCO camps. Check alimco.in for camp schedules.

name: ADIP Scheme — Assistive Devices for Persons with Disability
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment / ALIMCO
description: Free/subsidized durable, modern assistive devices to persons with disabilities (PwD) to improve their physical, social, and psychological rehabilitation.
eligibility: Persons with at least 40% disability (certified)
Annual family income below ₹20,000 (free) or ₹35,000 (subsidized)
Indian citizen aged 5+ years
benefits: Free: artificial limbs, wheelchairs, crutches, hearing aids, Braille kits, white canes, tricycles, smart canes for income up to ₹20K/year.
how_to_apply: Apply through local District Disability Rehabilitation Centre (DDRC) or ALIMCO offices. Visit alimco.in

name: Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan (PMSMA)
ministry: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare / NHM
description: Free antenatal check-ups on the 9th of every month at government health facilities for all pregnant women.
eligibility: All pregnant women in their 2nd or 3rd trimester — no income restriction
benefits: Free ANC package including blood pressure, weight, blood/urine tests, ultrasound, iron tablets, and specialist consultation on every 9th of the month.
how_to_apply: Visit any government PHC/CHC/District Hospital on the 9th of every month. No appointment needed. Register at pmsma.nhp.gov.in

name: Mission Indradhanush — Free Immunization
description: Universal immunization program to fully vaccinate all children (0-2 years) and pregnant women against 12 vaccine-preventable diseases.
eligibility: All children from 0 to 2 years
All pregnant women
benefits: Free vaccines: BCG, OPV, Pentavalent, PCV, Rotavirus, Measles-Rubella, JE (in endemic areas), Td (pregnant women), Hepatitis B. Home delivery by ASHA worker possible.
how_to_apply: Visit nearest Anganwadi, PHC, or government hospital. Vaccination camps held regularly. Track on eVin app.

name: Ayushman Arogya Mandir (Health & Wellness Centres)
ministry: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare / NHM
description: Upgraded Sub-Health Centres and PHCs offering comprehensive primary healthcare including yoga, mental health, and NCD screening within 2km of villages.
eligibility: All citizens in the catchment area — no restriction
benefits: Free services: NCD screening (diabetes, BP, cancer), teleconsultation, dental care, eye care, mental health, yoga sessions, and essential medicines.
how_to_apply: Visit nearest Ayushman Arogya Mandir (earlier known as Health & Wellness Centre) in your village or ward.

name: POSHAN Abhiyan (National Nutrition Mission)
description: Mission to improve nutritional outcomes for children, pregnant women, and lactating mothers through Anganwadi services and behavior change.
eligibility: Children aged 0-6 years
Pregnant women
Lactating mothers
Adolescent girls
benefits: Free supplementary nutrition (take-home rations and hot cooked meals), growth monitoring, health checkup, pre-school education, and referral to NRC for severely malnourished children.
how_to_apply: Register child or mother at nearest Anganwadi Centre. Find centre on poshan.gov.in.

name: Ayushman Bharat for e-Shram Workers
description: Unorganized sector workers registered on e-Shram portal are extended PM-JAY health insurance coverage of ₹5 lakh per year.
eligibility: Workers registered on the e-Shram portal (migrant workers, construction workers, gig workers)
Annual income less than ₹2.5 lakh
Not a member of EPFO/ESIC
benefits: ₹5 lakh cashless health insurance per year at 29,000+ empanelled hospitals — same as PM-JAY.
how_to_apply: Register at eshram.gov.in first. Then generate Ayushman card at pmjay.gov.in or empanelled hospital.
